correctness.rationale: Each of eight octahedral triangular facets has Euclidean area sqrt(3)/2. Each perpendicular origin section is the regular hexagon of area 3sqrt(3)/4 and self-volume 3 (six unit norm edges/2). Exactly applying Definition 4.1 yields omega_3=8*(sqrt(3)/2)*3/(3sqrt(3)/4)/3=16/3. The cited product law, also proved via boundary components, yields 16*3^(k-1)/3, strict factor 8/9 below 2*3^k for every k>=1. Standalone verifier runs exact symbolic checks; they corroborate the proof.
